aboutH2: Terradyne Wellness Centre: Inpatient Program & Aftercare in Beaver Bank, Nova Scotia
intro: Terradyne Wellness Center is a renowned facility that specializes in addiction, substance abuse, and chronic relapse. Located in Beaver Bank, just outside Halifax, Nova Scotia, the center provides personalized evidence-based treatment to empower clients to regain control of their lives. With a range of programs, Terradyne serves as a beacon of hope for individuals struggling with addiction or substance abuse.

Terradyne Wellness Center offers a range of services to cater to the unique needs of each client. Their inpatient program runs for 30-90 days and is designed to provide a safe and supportive environment for individuals on the path to recovery. Additionally, the facility offers continuing aftercare to ensure that clients receive adequate support to maintain their sobriety and transition back into their daily routine.

pillars.title: Facility Setting & Activities
pillars.body: Terradyne Wellness Center is located in an ideal setting close to several lakes in Beaver Bank, Nova Scotia, with comfortable, updated furnishing. Clients start their day with meditation or exercise and engage in educational workshops before lunch. After lunch, they have access to various recreational activities such as hiking, personal training, or off-site 12-step meetings. The day ends with yoga classes, Reiki sessions, sound healing workshops, music therapy sessions, movies, and games.

pillars.title: Professional Recovery Coaching & Occupational Transition Planning
pillars.body: Terradyne’s team of professionals provides expert care, including personalized and professional coaching to help clients reintegrate into society confidently. They offer occupational transition planning and practical skills that empower clients to succeed in their lives and careers.

pillars.title: Therapeutic Approaches & Workshops
pillars.body: Terradyne’s clinical team boasts a range of experience and certifications in therapeutic approaches like CBT, DBT, mindfulness, strengths-based therapy, and trauma-informed therapy. Clients receive 1-on-1 therapy each week and participate in educational workshops that focus on relapse prevention, goal setting, positive psychology, emotional intelligence, or solution-focused planning.

overview: Our team of professionals at Terradyne have decades of experience and incorporate a wide variety of recovery approaches to treat addiction. Our team includes doctors, psychiatrists, therapists, counsellors and other specialists who work together to address the individual needs of each client. Our approach is not a one-size-fits-all model, we understand that each client is unique and requires individualized care.

afterOverview: At Terradyne, our mission is to provide a holistic approach to rehabilitation that addresses not only the addiction but also the underlying causes and mental health issues. Our comprehensive wellness program includes nutritional counselling, physical activity, mindfulness and meditation practices, and other wellness therapies. Our goal is to not only help clients achieve sobriety but to help them rebuild a healthy, fulfilling life, free from the destruction of addiction. We are dedicated to providing the tools and resources necessary for clients to achieve a successful long-term recovery.

location.heading: Terradyne Wellness Centre in Beaver Bank, Nova Scotia
location.intro: Terradyne Wellness Centre is on Kinsac Road in Beaver Bank, a rural part of the Halifax Regional Municipality north of Lower Sackville, with several lakes and plenty of woodland close by. Downtown Halifax is about 35 minutes away by car, Bedford and Lower Sackville are 15 to 20 minutes, Dartmouth and Halifax Stanfield International Airport are each around half an hour, and Truro is roughly an hour up Highway 102.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Terradyne Wellness Centre cost?
faqs.a: Terradyne does not post prices on its own website and asks you to call 902-334-4704 for current packages. Its recovery.com profile gives estimated all-inclusive cash rates from $13,500 for a semi-private room and from $18,500 for a private king suite, with $13,500 and up named as the usual cost for 30 days. Extra days can be added to a package at a daily rate, up to 90 days.

faqs.q: Did Terradyne move from Head of Jeddore?
faqs.a: Yes. Terradyne now runs its residential program from a six-bed house at 293 Kinsac Road in Beaver Bank, about 35 minutes by car from downtown Halifax. Older listings, including an earlier version of this page, gave an address on Myers Point Road in Head of Jeddore on the Eastern Shore, which the centre's own team page now calls its previous location. Call before you travel so the team can plan your arrival.

faqs.q: What is the duration of the inpatient program?
faqs.a: The inpatient program at Terradyne typically runs for 30-90 days, depending on the client’s needs.

Yes, for people who qualify. Withdrawal is managed on site with round-the-clock monitoring and medication for symptoms, and methadone or Suboxone can be used for opioid withdrawal. The centre says detox usually takes 3 to 10 days, and you then move straight into the residential program.

faqs.q: Is Terradyne private? Can I use insurance?
faqs.a: Terradyne is a private, fee-based centre. It is on the provider lists for Blue Cross and Canada Life, and depending on your plan, treatment may be partly or fully covered, so check with your insurer first. Financing is available through Medicard, which pays the centre directly and lets you spread the cost over monthly payments.

Adults aged 19 and older. Terradyne is a co-ed residential centre, and someone who has recently finished a prison sentence can be admitted as long as the sentence was not for a violent offence. Family and friends are encouraged to visit, because family counselling is part of the program.

faqs.q: What types of addiction and substance abuse does Terradyne treat?
faqs.a: Terradyne specializes in treating addiction and substance abuse. Their team provides comprehensive treatment for a range of substances, including alcohol, opioids, cocaine, methamphetamine, and others.
Continuing aftercare at Terradyne includes ongoing support and resources to help clients maintain their sobriety and transition back into their daily routine, which includes personalized coaching.

Every package includes a 12-month virtual aftercare program. Alumni can join the weekday psychoeducation classes and group sessions on Zoom as often as they need for a year after they leave, and families can keep learning through the Family Care Program.

faqs.q: What approaches does Terradyne use for treatment?
faqs.a: Terradyne employs evidence-based approaches such as CBT, DBT, mindfulness, strengths-based therapy, and trauma-informed therapy.

faqs.q: Does Terradyne offer individual therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, clients receive 1-on-1 therapy each week.

faqs.q: Can clients participate in educational workshops at Terradyne?
faqs.a: Yes, educational workshops are a significant part of the Terradyne experience, with topics ranging from goal setting to emotional intelligence.

faqs.q: What are the recreational activities offered at Terradyne?
faqs.a: Clients have access to a variety of recreational activities such as hiking, personal training, or off-site 12-step meetings.

faqs.q: Does Terradyne offer holistic wellness programs?
faqs.a: Yes, clients at Terradyne have access to yoga classes, Reiki sessions, sound healing workshops, and music therapy sessions.
